Name: windowNameOrUri
Description: What to open: either the url of the view to load (starts with ~ or /) or the name of a window definition registered on the server with options.Config.CreateWindow(name, path, did, parameters)

Name: did
Description: The d-id of the container where the window opens. Required when the first parameter is a url; ignored when it is a window definition name, because the definition already carries its did

Name: ParameterKey
Description: The parameter key that you want to pass to the window

Name: ParameterValue
Description: The parameter value that you want to pass to the window. ParameterKey and ParameterValue can be used several times
